summary: Backend regression 33/33 PASSING (was 27/31). All 4 previously-failing spec regressions now pass: POST /api/me/location returns {zone_verified, distance_m} with zone_verified=true inside UB 3km and false for Jakarta; POST /api/posts rejects Jakarta with 400; GET /api/stats/impact includes zone {name,lat,lng,radius_m}; GET /api/posts with radius_km=3 returns all 4 seeded posts and radius_km=0.5 returns fewer, distance_m always numeric. Frontend E2E: landing counter + T&C + get-started OK; login (rina/budi/sari/admin) OK; feed loads with cards, category chips and radius filters work with no console errors; post detail Leaflet map renders with no 'already initialized' error; full post creation E2E (photo upload, 4 steps, dropoff+privacy_offset, responsibility_ack, publish → /post/{id}) works; full donor/recipient roundtrip works end-to-end (claim → chat/WS → donor Terima → chat reply → donor Selesai → recipient Selesai → thumbs-up rating → trust score updates); report submission from post detail shows success toast; admin panel loads, Review approves pending post, Laporan resolves a report, Warga ban button works (but see issues below); new-user onboarding role→tutorial→detect-location→zone-result→feed all work with granted geolocation.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires radius 0.5/1/3 km filter chips, but code only defines radii = [0.5, 1] — filter-radius-3 does not exist and default radius is 1km, so seeded posts up to 3km can be hidden from the feed even though backend now correctly accepts radius_km=3.

Spec/req mentions a 'Pakai titik tengah kampus UB saja' fallback button — only detect-location-btn and skip-location-btn exist. Users who deny geolocation must skip without a zone check instead of using the UB center fallback.

Admin can ban themself (own row not filtered/disabled). After clicking ban-{admin_id} the admin gets logged out on next request (403 'Akun kamu diblokir'). Users list also does not refresh after ban/unban so unban button doesn't appear until page reload.

issues: Feed default radius=1km hides posts within 1–3km even though backend allows 3km. Combined with missing 3km chip, users may see empty feed.

action_items: Add filter-radius-3 to /app/frontend/src/pages/Feed.js radii array (v:3) so recipients can widen search to the full pilot zone. Consider bumping default radius to 3km to match spec.
Add a 'Pakai titik tengah kampus UB saja' button in Onboarding step 3 that calls /api/me/location with PILOT_CENTER (or renders data-testid=use-zone-center-btn) so the spec'd flow is testable.

In Admin.js Warga tab, hide the ban button for the current admin's own row (or disable when u.role==='admin') and refresh the user list after ban/unban succeeds. Testing agent had to unban admin manually via mongo after ban-{admin_id} was clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: Feed.js hard-codes only two radii — this is the primary UX regression relative to spec.
Admin.js does not defensively prevent self-ban; a single misclick locks the admin account and requires DB access to recover.

Onboarding provides no explicit zone-center fallback button — users with denied geolocation take the 'Nanti saja' path and never get zone_verified=true, so they'll be blocked when POST /api/posts enforces the pilot zone.
server.py enrich_post correctly falls back to PILOT_CENTER when neither viewer.location nor query lat/lng is supplied — distance_m is guaranteed numeric.
post-map / detail-map: MiniMap component correctly avoids double-initialization; no console errors seen across ~15 navigations.

success_rate.frontend: critical flows all pass; 2 UI gaps (radius=3 chip, zone-center fallback) and 1 admin safety bug (self-ban)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green — do not modify server.py. Only frontend changes are required: (1) add filter-radius-3 chip in Feed.js, (2) add use-zone-center-btn in Onboarding.js step 3 that POSTs {lat:-7.9526,lng:112.6142} to /api/me/location, (3) guard Admin.js Warga tab so admins cannot self-ban and the list refreshes after ban/unban. All backend regressions in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py should stay green.
rca of the issue: Root causes: (a) Feed radii array missing 3km entry — cosmetic omission during initial UI build. (b) Onboarding missing the 'use zone center' shortcut button — spec required an explicit fallback distinct from 'Nanti saja'. (c) Admin.js renders a ban button for every user row including admins; combined with no self-ban guard and no list refresh, the admin lockout can happen on a single click. Reproduction of self-ban: login admin → /admin → tab Warga → click the last ban button (oldest user = admin themselves) → next protected request returns 403 with 'Akun kamu diblokir' and admin session breaks. Mitigation: filter u.role!=='admin' when rendering ban-{id} rows and reload /admin/users after mutations.
